sections.heading: Overview
bullets: A single-phase DPS check built around a poison-mushroom floor, a repeating sleep/fear cycle, and a rotating fixate that moves the boss around the arena. 7-minute enrage.

sections.heading: Tantrum & Narcolepsy
bullets: Tantrum: 3 ground pounds drop dark circles under each player — a 4th stack knocks you down for 5 seconds. Stop moving once it starts so you're not spreading the AoEs around the arena; dodge, block, or invuln each pound.
Every 20% health (and again at 10%), Slothasor falls asleep with a breakbar — breaking it applies a 10-second fear to the whole squad, so have stability, aegis, or a stunbreak ready.

sections.heading: Poison mushrooms & Volatile Poison
bullets: The floor starts covered in poison from red mushrooms — 4 players transform into Slublings (via blue Imbued Mushrooms) and eat the red ones to clear safe zones. A transformed player can't transform again for 4 minutes, and the rest of the squad shouldn't cleave, pull, or stun their own Slublings.

Every 25 seconds someone gets Volatile Poison — carry it away from the group and drop it; it expands to cover roughly a third of the arena. It drops early if unused for 8s, you go down, or you eat an imbued mushroom.

sections.heading: Fire Breath & Spore Release
bullets: Fire Breath: Slothasor stops and breathes fire in front of him — dodge, block, or sidestep out. He usually faces the tank, but not always, so stay alert even from behind.
From 50% health onward, Spore Release pulses poison/torment/confusion/vulnerability outward — dodge away, pause a beat, then dodge back into his hitbox rather than standing in the spore ring.

sections.heading: Fixate & adds
bullets: A random player is fixated every 30 seconds (sound cue + purple diamond) — move the boss onto the most recently cleared mushroom patch and hold position there.
Slublings that aren't dealt with become Evolved Slublings and corrupt boons — use pulls and ranged cleave on them, carefully, without hitting your own transformed players.

sections.heading: Enrage
bullets: 7:00 — Imbued Mushrooms stop spawning and Slothasor deals +200% damage.
